confidence_notes: I used three of the six allowed searches. Peak season (July) affects every anchor. Restaurant meal anchors come from 2026 travel-guide INR ranges: about Rs 150-450 per meal at budget and mid-range places, and Rs 400-800 at Western-style cafés. I assumed about 88-90 INR per USD from general knowledge. I found no INR price for a cappuccino in Leh. One budget aggregator gave a generic coffee price of $2, so the cappuccino anchor is mostly an estimate from café pricing in Leh tourist areas. Draft beer is rare in Leh, so the beer anchor reflects a typical restaurant beer serving. Searches did not find Leh-specific prices for cocktails or wine. Those anchors come from their usual price ratio to beer in Indian tourist restaurants and are uncertain. Accommodation anchors are general model estimates for July peak season, not taken from booking pages. Leh has limited supply of hostels and 3-star hotels, so real prices could vary widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis: other Indian Himalayan tourist towns such as Manali and McLeod Ganj. Leh is priced higher because supplies are trucked or flown in, the season is short, and July is peak demand. Spirits and cocktail pricing uses Indian tourist-restaurant norms.
